app.heading: Tablely · Wholesale order tables
design.title: Design
design.appearanceHint: Styles are applied to the order table on your storefront and take effect immediately after saving.
design.brandColorHint: Used for the submit button and the keyboard focus outline. Leave empty to follow your theme's text color.
design.radiusHint: 0–24 pixels. Leave empty to use the default.
design.densityHint: Controls the padding inside table rows.
design.fontHint: Following the theme is the most compatible choice.
design.taxDisplayHint: How prices are shown in relation to tax.
design.outOfStockHint: What customers see for variants that cannot be ordered.
design.feedbackStyleHint: Where add-to-cart results appear after submitting.
design.hideNative: Hide the theme's own add-to-cart section
design.hideNativeHint: Off by default. The switch is ignored automatically when the order table is not shown.
design.selectorHint: Leave empty to use form[action*="/cart/add"]. Only applies to product pages where the order table is shown.
design.previewDisabled: Enable an order table on a product first to preview.
design.advancedHelp: How to add the order table to your theme
overview.title: Overview
overview.placeholder: Tablely is being set up. The configuration pages arrive in the next build steps.
tables.title: Order tables
tables.shopDefaultHint: Applies to every product that doesn't set its own minimum. Leave blank for no minimum.
tables.selectAll: Select all rows on this page
tables.tooManyVariants: This product has more than {n} variants. Only the first {n} can be shown in one table.
quota.overLimit: {used} of {limit} products — free plan limit reached
empty.tables.title: Create your first order table
empty.tables.body: Turn individual variant clicks into a bulk order form: tax-excluded prices, tier pricing and minimum quantities.
empty.search.title: No matching products
drawer.heading: Order table settings
drawer.notFoundBody: This product is no longer available. Close this panel and pick another one.
drawer.enabled: Show the order table on this product
drawer.orderMinHint: Leave blank to inherit the store default. Applies to the pre-discount subtotal.
drawer.rulesHint: Set a minimum, maximum and step for each variant. Leave max blank for no limit.
drawer.saveAsTemplateHint: Store this product's layout, columns, rules and minimum as a reusable template.
templates.title: Layout templates
templates.name: Template name
templates.empty: No templates yet. Open a product table and use “Save as template”.
templates.selectedHint: {n} products selected in the table below.
templates.overwriteRules: Also overwrite variant rules and minimum order
templates.overwriteHint: Leave unchecked to keep the rules you edited by hand on each product.
templates.overflow: {n} products were skipped (limit {limit} per run). Apply again to finish.
